jobs.title: Sales Advisor  | Contratto a Chiamata | Forlì
jobs.description: COSA FARAI Come Sales Advisor in H&M, avrai un ruolo fondamentale nel creare un’eccezionale esperienza al cliente. Accoglierai i clienti, li guiderai all’interno del negozio e li supporterai nella scelta, valorizzando i nostri prodotti. Agendo in linea con i nostri valori, contribuirai al tuo successo e a quello dell’azienda.  Ti occuperai di:  Condividere la tua conoscenza della moda e dei prodotti per aiutare i clienti a fare scelte accurate.  Collaborare con il tuo team per offrire un servizio eccezionale in ogni fase del percorso del cliente.  Garantire che l’area vendita e il magazzino siano sempre ben forniti, ordinati e accoglienti.  Supportare le attività di apertura e chiusura del negozio. Rappresentare te stesso e il brand in modo positivo durante tutte le interazioni con i clienti.  CON CHI LAVORERAI  I nostri negozi sono il cuore pulsante della nostra azienda, dove i clienti vivono in prima persona l’esperienza del brand. Come parte del dinamico Team del negozio, ogni ruolo - Sales Advisor, Department Manager, Store Manager e Visual Merchandiser - contribuisce a creare un ambiente ispirante e accogliente. Avrai anche l’opportunità di collaborare con il Team di Area, condividendo idee e strategie per raggiungere insieme il successo.  Con il tuo team, giocherai un ruolo fondamentale nell’aiutare i clienti a sentirsi sicuri di sé ed esprimere la propria individualità, grazie alle ultime tendenze e agli stili intramontabili.  Creando connessioni autentiche con i clienti nei nostri negozi, rendiamo la moda accessibile   per tutti.    ​ CHI SEI  Cerchiamo persone con:  Esperienza nel servizio al cliente, preferibilmente nel settore moda, retail o ambiti affini.  E persone che siano:  Appassionate di fashion e orientate a offrire un’eccezionale esperienza in-store, promuovendo i nostri prodotti e contribuendo a raggiungere gli obiettivi di vendita.  Proattive e capaci di lavorare in ambienti collaborativi e dinamici.  Comunicative, creative, curiose nell’utilizzo della tecnologia in negozio, con una forte motivazione ad apprendere e svilupparsi.   Flessibili e orientate all’azione.  CHI SIAMO   H&M Group è un’azienda globale che riunisce diversi brand di moda e business ventures. Il nostro obiettivo è dimostrare che non esiste compromesso tra design eccezionale, prezzi accessibili e soluzioni sostenibili. Vogliamo rendere la moda libera e accessibile a tutti, mettendo i nostri clienti al centro di ogni decisione. Siamo migliaia di colleghi appassionati e di talento, uniti dalla nostra cultura e da valori condivisi. Insieme, vogliamo usare la nostra forza, la nostra conoscenza e le nostre competenze per guidare l’industria della moda verso un futuro più inclusivo e sostenibile.  ​PERCHÉ TI PIACERÀ LAVORARE CON NOI  In H&M Group siamo orgogliosi di essere un’azienda dinamica e inclusiva. L’esperienza che i nostri colleghi contribuiscono a creare ogni giorno è stata anche riconosciuta attraverso premi come: Europe’s Best Employers 2026 – Financial Times Top 10 Diversity Brand Index Italia. Offriamo ai nostri dipendenti benefit vantaggiosi e numerose opportunità di sviluppo a livello globale.  Sconto del 25% per i dipendenti su tutti i brand di H&M Group, sia nei negozi fisici che online (H&M, COS, Weekday, Monki, H&M HOME, & Other Stories e ARKET).  Programma di Incentivi H&M (HIP) – un piano di incentivi globale che premia la dedizione a lungo termine.  Buoni pasto di 6 euro per ogni giornata lavorativa di almeno 6 ore.  Accesso al portale aziendale dedicato ai benefit, con oltre 1500 sconti su prodotti e servizi per il benessere e la vita quotidiana.  Formazione iniziale dedicata, per accompagnarti al meglio nel tuo percorso in azienda.  Crescita e sviluppo - In H&M investiamo nello sviluppo dei talenti attraverso formazione continua e percorsi strutturati come training, e-learning, Talent Day, Skill Seminar e dialoghi individuali. Crediamo nella crescita professionale come parte integrante dell’esperienza lavorativa. UNISCITI A NOI La nostra unicità nasce dalla combinazione di molti elementi: una cultura inclusiva e collaborativa, valori forti e reali opportunità di crescita. Sono soprattutto le persone a renderci ciò che siamo. Fai il prossimo passo nella tua carriera insieme a noi. Il tuo percorso inizia qui. ALTRE INFORMAZIONI Retribuzione contratto Job on Call: Per questo ruolo offriamo una retribuzione oraria fissa di € 9,87 lordi all’ora, corrispondente al Livello di inquadramento 5° (CCNL di riferimento: Commercio) + terzo elemento provinciale, variabile in funzione della provincia sede di lavoro.  * Valutazione per Ruoli in store: p er gestire l'alto volume di candidature per il ruolo di Sales Advisor, utilizziamo un metodo di valutazione online per il reclutamento basato sulle competenze nei nostri negozi. Dovrai completarlo come parte del processo di candidatura e selezione. Le tue risposte saranno valutate da uno strumento di valutazione che applica criteri predefiniti stabiliti da H&M Group. Dopo aver completato la valutazione, avrai l'opportunità di condividere feedback e fare domande. Se riscontri difficoltà o preferisci un metodo di valutazione alternativo, contatta  recruitment_support@hm.com . Scegliere un'alternativa non influirà sulla tua candidatura. Per ulteriori informazioni su come trattiamo i tuoi dati personali, consulta la nostra Informativa sulla Privacy. ** Ci impegniamo in un processo di recruitment che sia equo, imparziale e basato sulle competenze.

jobs.title: Business Analyst - Digital Product
jobs.description: As Business Analyst, you will be part of the COS Product Team. You will collaborate with the Product Manager and Business Experts to craft seamless experiences by understanding business objectives and technological capabilities to ensure we solve real customer problems. You will be  responsible for facilitating the development process by gathering information, supporting to prioritise backlogs and drive feature development. You will take ownership for managing Jira backlog health and Jira tickets to ensure speed, a smooth collaboration and alignment on new initiatives. What you will do:  Secure Jira governance and improvements to guidelines, ensure stakeholders are onboarded  and delivering to expectations. Improve health of the backlog, increasing the % of well-defined user stories ready for development.  Facilitate agile ceremonies, including backlog refinement sessions, and ensure that development tasks are well-defined and actionable. Support the Product Manager with organising and leading stakeholder meetings and non-technical workshops to encourage cross-functional engagement and feedback. Coordinate with operational and development teams to resolve incidents and maintain system performance. Host knowledge transfer sessions or onboarding support for new team members or external consultants.​ Engage with UX/UI design teams to ensure business requirements are reflected in user experiences Work with Data Analysts/Engineers to ensure data definitions and metrics are consistent and trustworthy​ Lead the creation and delivery of feature requests, ensuring alignment with business goals and technical feasibility Participate in daily stand-ups, sprint planning, retrospectives, and demos to align with delivery progress and team goals. Maintain confluence pages, or dashboards to track requirement status, business rules, and changes.

jobs.title: Social Media Specialist
jobs.description: The Social Media Specialist will support the growth and evolution of our social channels, combining creativity, cultural awareness and data-led thinking to deliver engaging, relevant and high-performing social content. Working across organic and paid social, the role will turn audience, platform and performance insights into actionable recommendations, helping to strengthen our social presence, grow our community and support wider brand and commercial objectives. What you will do:  Grow and evolve our social channels:  Drive continuous content, community and performance analysis to identify opportunities for channel growth. Develop recommendations in partnership with the Social Media Manager and Head of Content and use performance insights to continually evolve social-first content.​ Drive social performance and optimisation:  Continuously evaluate social performance, translating data into actionable insights and regular reporting. Maximise the impact of paid social by using social insights, trends, content learnings and creator opportunities to inform and optimise paid strategy, with a particular focus on TikTok.​ Build brand relevance through social:  Stay ahead of the evolving social landscape, identifying emerging trends, platform behaviours, creators and formats across Instagram, TikTok as well as wider and emerging social platforms. Translate these into relevant opportunities for COS and ensure the brand remains culturally relevant and progressive.​ Shape social-first creative:  Partner closely with the Social Media team, Art Directors and Copy team to inform and develop creative for shoots and social channels. Use audience insights, trend analysis, platform expertise and performance data to help shape creative direction, maximise relevance and evolve the social tone of voice.​ Develop social partnerships and opportunities:  Partner with the Paid Media team on paid social activity, with a particular focus on TikTok, sharing insights, trends, content learnings and creator opportunities. Identify opportunities across creators, cultural moments, emerging formats and social commerce to support channel and commercial growth.​ Collaborate across the business:  Coordinate cross-functional workflows from content ideation through to execution, managing briefs, timelines and delivery. Contribute social expertise and insights to wider brand activity and maintain strong relationships with external platform representatives to identify opportunities to develop our channels.​

jobs.title: Sales Advisor 8h, 12h and 20h
jobs.description: As the Sales Advisor, you are the friendly face that greet our customers and embody the heart of our brand.  You'll have the opportunity to provide customers with high-level service at every turn. From initiating conversations to assisting at the cash desk, fitting rooms and throughout the shop floor, you'll play a vital role in enhancing the shopping experience. Your responsibilities will also include processing deliveries, replenishing stock and merchandising the latest garments on the shop floor.  Your role is essential in creating welcoming experiences that showcase the best of our brand. With warmth and enthusiasm, you'll guide our customers through their journey, offering genuine assistance and proactive service to uplift and inspire. Together, in collaboration with your team, you’ll create moments that matter.  While previous experience in customer service and familiarity with fabrics are nice to have, they're not mandatory.

jobs.title: Sales Advisor (20 ore)
jobs.description: Come Sales Advisor, sei il volto amichevole che accoglie i nostri clienti e incarna il cuore del nostro brand.  Avrai l’opportunità di offrire ai clienti un servizio di alto livello in ogni momento. Dall’iniziare conversazioni all’assistenza alla cassa, nei camerini e sullo shop floor, svolgerai un ruolo fondamentale nel migliorare l’esperienza di acquisto. Le tue responsabilità includeranno anche la gestione delle consegne, il rifornimento dello stock e il merchandising dei capi più recenti sullo shop floor.  Il tuo ruolo è essenziale per creare esperienze accoglienti che mostrino il meglio del nostro brand. Con calore ed entusiasmo, guiderai i clienti nel loro percorso, offrendo assistenza autentica e un servizio proattivo per ispirare e valorizzare. In collaborazione con il tuo team, creerai momenti che contano.  Sebbene l’esperienza precedente nel servizio clienti e la familiarità con i tessuti siano un plus, non sono requisiti obbligatori.

jobs.title: Assistant Buyer - Menswear
jobs.description: As an Assistant Buyer on the menswear team, you will support product development across all knitwear categories. You will contribute to driving sales and profitability by supporting the development of a strong, customer‑focused assortment aligned with COS aesthetics. Working closely with Buying, Design, Pattern, Production, Material, and Supply Chain teams, you will help secure orders that meet brand and customer requirements across time, price, quality, and quantity, supporting meaningful growth within the department. What you will do: Be part of reviewing and analysing the departments product, assortment, quantity and selling, considering actions according to the business needs and present sales figures. Support to maximize the departments sales and profitability by maintaining timelines both before and after order replacement. Monitor and react to how the departments customers are affected by trends and their surroundings Drive the day-to-day organization within your team Manage the post flow to and from recipients Conduct regular analysis of our competitors and provide insights to your team, ensuring we offer our customers great value for money. Communicate with the production office regarding product development. Follow up order placements and meet deadlines. Support with driving the product development from start to end and in close collaboration with the buyer and in line with dept margin targets. Prepare and assist fittings, organize agenda, provide samples at the right place, right time and right quantity. Responsible for handling samples as well as overseeing and maintain the sample wardrobe, making sure all samples are kept neat and tidy Raise orders and order updates.

jobs.title: SALES ADVISOR - OXFORD STREET EAST (PART-TIME)
jobs.description: These are temporary part-time 8, 16 & 20 hour positions based in the H&M Oxford Street East store in Central London. For this position we will require 2-5 days flexibility, including the weekends.   WHAT YOU’LL DO ​ As a H&M Sales Advisor, you will be essential in delivering an exceptional shopping experience. Some of your responsibilities will include: ​Representing the H&M Brand positively and engaging with our customers to provide an excellent service and an exciting shopping experience. Supporting with commercial and operational actions together with your colleagues, to reach store goals and sales targets. Keep informed about the latest fashion trends, brands and competitors, using your knowledge to inspire and guide our customers. Providing and receiving feedback to support yourself and your colleagues to learn and develop.   WHO YOU’LL WORK WITH ​ Our stores are the heart of our company, where customers will experience our brand firsthand. Being part of a dynamic Store Team, which include, Sales Advisors, Team Leaders, Department Managers, Visual Merchandisers and Store Managers, together you will create an inspirational environment for our customer and colleagues.   WHO YOU ARE ​ We welcome applicants who are: Passionate about people and fashion. Self-motivated and able to motivate others to ensure strong teamwork. Clear communicators, creative and curious. Motivated to contribute to H&M's vision, leading us to success.   WHO WE ARE ​ H&M Group is a global company of strong fashion brands and ventures. Our goal is to prove that there is no compromise between exceptional design, affordable prices, and sustainable solutions. We want to liberate fashion for the many, and our customers are at the heart of every decision we make.​ ​We are made up of thousands of passionate and talented colleagues united by our shared culture and values. Together, we want to use our power, our scale, and our knowledge to push the fashion industry towards a more inclusive and sustainable future. ​   WHY YOU’LL LOVE WORKING HERE  ​ At H&M Group, we are proud to be a vibrant and welcoming company. We offer our employees attractive benefits with extensive development opportunities around the globe. ​[Please see below some of the benefits available to our Sales Advisors] Global Employee Discount of 25% across the H&M Group [H&M, COS, & Other Stories, Monki, Weekday, Arket and H&M Home] Health and Lifestyle Benefits The Retail Trust – Employee Assistance Programme Benefit Hub, offering exclusive discounts Company Sick Pay Workplace Pension Scheme   JOIN US ​ Our uniqueness comes from a combination of many things – our inclusive and collaborative culture, our strong values, and opportunities for growth. But most of all, it’s our people who make us who we are.​ Take the next step in your career together with us. The journey starts here.​   ADDITIONAL INFORMATION Unfortunately, this is not a position that we are able to offer sponsorship for under the skilled worker route. Should you decide to apply for one of our Sales Advisor positions, you will be asked to complete an online interactive assessment as part of your application. Here you will answer a series of questions, all based on the role and the responsibilities of a Sales Advisor in H&M. Please do keep an eye out for this email and link, as it may end up in your junk mail. *For more information on how we process your personal data, please see our Privacy Notice. ** W e are committed to a recruitment process that is fair, equitable, and based on competency. We therefore kindly ask you not to attach a cover letter to your application.

jobs.title: Visual Merchandiser Manager, Regent St
jobs.description: As a Visual Merchandiser Manager, you play a pivotal role in shaping an exceptional in-store customer journey. With a keen eye for aesthetics and a strong commercial mindset, you bring the brand's vision to life, elevating the collection in a way that is both inspiring and aligned with business goals. Supporting the Area Visual Manager, you drive consistent and elevated visual merchandising execution across your responsible stores, ensuring brand standards are delivered while adapting to local market needs. Your work enhances the visual appeal of the store, strengthens customer engagement, and contributes to sales performance through commercially impactful visual presentations. Key Responsibilities:  Deliver an exceptional customer experience through inspiring visual merchandising, styling expertise, and strong product knowledge. Execute Global Visual Brand Guidelines across windows, mannequins, and in-store displays to ensure a consistent and commercial customer experience. Interpret sales performance, customer insights, and local market trends to drive visual merchandising decisions and commercial results. Adapt regional visual direction to local market needs while maintaining brand consistency and integrity. Plan and implement impactful window displays, mannequin styling, and shop floor presentations that inspire customers and support business goals. Conduct regular store visits, monitor visual standards, and provide coaching and feedback to enhance execution across responsible stores. Lead, develop, and inspire a team of Visual Merchandiser(s), ensuring high standards and consistent delivery. Collaborate with the Area Visual Manager and Store Management teams to implement visual updates, share best practices, and drive continuous improvement. Monitor and report on visual merchandising performance, identifying opportunities to improve standards and results. Act as a brand ambassador and visual merchandising expert, ensuring every visual touchpoint enhances the customer journey.

jobs.title: Department (Concession) Manager
jobs.description: As a Department Manager  you’re be at the forefront of creating excellent customer experiences that go beyond the expected.  With a passionate and dedicated team by your side, you will lead with energy and purpose—setting the tone for a store environment that’s not only welcoming and inspiring but also drives results. Your leadership ensures every customer journey feels personal, genuine, and memorable, while your focus on service and operational excellence helps bring the brand to life on the shop floor.  Key Responsibilities  Deliver a high level of customer service through expert styling advice, strong product knowledge, and an engaging store experience  Analyse sales data and collaborate with the Store/Concession Manager to maximise department performance  Lead and motivate a team of Sales Advisors to consistently achieve service and presentation standards  Support recruitment efforts and ensure effective onboarding and training for new team members  Identify and nurture future talent, contributing to development plans that support team progression  Oversee daily store operations, ensuring efficiency and alignment with brand standards  Act as a brand ambassador, consistently delivering the best possible experience for every customer  Step into the role of Store  Manager when required, ensuring continuity in leadership and performance

jobs.title: Department Manager | Parma
jobs.description: COSA FARAI In qualità di Department Manager, sarai una figura chiave nel supportare, incoraggiare e ispirare il team, favorendo collaborazione, coinvolgimento e il raggiungimento degli obiettivi comuni. Promuoverai una cultura inclusiva che valorizza la collaborazione e stimola lo spirito imprenditoriale, creando un ambiente in cui ogni persona possa crescere e svilupparsi. Agendo in linea con i nostri valori, contribuirai attivamente non solo al successo del team, ma anche a quello dell’intera azienda. Le tue responsabilità includeranno: Guidare il team nel garantire un’esperienza cliente eccellente, assicurando elevati standard operativi e di visual merchandising, e promuovendo attivamente la vendita dei prodotti. Essere responsabile delle performance del proprio reparto: analizzare i risultati di vendita, identificare opportunità commerciali e definire obiettivi chiari, sviluppando piani d’azione per ottimizzare vendite, profittabilità e gestione dello stock Gestire efficacemente la pianificazione del team, assicurando il corretto svolgimento delle routine di apertura e chiusura del punto vendita. Selezionare, inserire e sviluppare i talenti del team, promuovendo una cultura inclusiva, collaborativa e orientata alla crescita continua e all’innovazione. Mantenersi costantemente aggiornato sulle tendenze moda, sulle preferenze dei clienti e sulle attività dei competitor, per garantire un’offerta sempre rilevante. Rappresentare il brand in modo positivo e coerente in ogni interazione con i clienti, incarnandone i valori e lo stile.    CON CHI LAVORERAI I nostri negozi sono il cuore della nostra azienda, il luogo in cui i clienti vivono in prima persona il nostro brand. Come parte del dinamico team di negozio, ogni ruolo contribuisce a creare un ambiente stimolante e accogliente. Collaborerai a stretto contatto anche con l’Area Team, lavorando in sinergia tra diversi negozi per condividere idee e favorire il successo comune. Insieme al team, avrai un ruolo fondamentale nell’aiutare i clienti a sentirsi sicuri di sé ed esprimere la propria individualità attraverso le ultime tendenze e uno stile senza tempo. Costruendo connessioni autentiche con i clienti, rendiamo la moda accessibile e sostenibile per tutti. ​ CHI SEI Cerchiamo persone con... ​ Esperienza nella gestione e nelle operazioni di vendita al dettaglio. Forti capacità di leadership, con una passione per il coaching e lo sviluppo dei team, esemplificando al contempo i valori e la cultura aziendale. Competenze nella pianificazione, analisi e follow-up delle vendite, utilizzando strumenti e reports incentrati sul cliente. E persone che... ​ Dimostrano una leadership solida e consapevole, ispirando, supportando e sviluppando il team con integrità. Eccellono in contesti collaborativi e dinamici, grazie a una spiccata capacità di problem solving. Sono motivate a creare esperienze straordinarie per i clienti, promuovendo e valorizzando i prodotti. L’obiettivo è dimostrare che non esiste compromesso tra design eccellente, prezzi accessibili e soluzioni sostenibili. La volontà è rendere la moda libera e accessibile a tutte le persone, mettendo i clienti al centro di ogni decisione. Il gruppo è composto da migliaia di persone appassionate e di talento, unite da una cultura e da valori condivisi. Insieme, vogliamo valorizzare la nostra forza, la nostra dimensione globale e le nostre competenze per guidare l’industria della moda verso un futuro più inclusivo e sostenibile.   PERCHÉ TI PIACERÀ LAVORARE CON NOI? In H&M Group siamo orgogliosi di essere un’azienda dinamica e inclusiva. L’esperienza che i nostri colleghi contribuiscono a creare ogni giorno è stata anche riconosciuta attraverso premi come: Europe’s Best Employers 2026 – Financial Times Top 10 Diversity Brand Index Italia. Offriamo ai nostri dipendenti benefit vantaggiosi e numerose opportunità di sviluppo a livello globale.  Sconto del 25% per il personale  su tutti i brand del Gruppo H&M, sia nei negozi fisici che online (H&M, COS, Weekday, Monki, H&M HOME, & Other Stories e ARKET). Programma di Incentivi H&M (HIP)  – un piano di incentivi globale che premia la dedizione a lungo termine. Buoni pasto di 6 euro  per ogni giornata lavorativa di almeno 6 ore. Accesso al portale di benefit aziendale , con oltre 1500 sconti su prodotti e servizi per il benessere e la vita quotidiana. Fondo Est -  fondo di assistenza sanitaria integrativa  prevista per i lavoratori dipendenti dei CCNL Terziario: istituito in favore di tutti i dipendenti a tempo indeterminato. Formazione iniziale  dedicata, per accompagnarti al meglio nel tuo percorso in azienda. Crescita e sviluppo -  In H&M investiamo nello sviluppo dei talenti attraverso formazione continua e percorsi strutturati come training, e-learning, Talent Day, Skill Seminar e dialoghi individuali. Crediamo nella crescita professionale come parte integrante dell’esperienza lavorativa.  UNISCITI A NOI La nostra unicità nasce da una combinazione di elementi: una cultura inclusiva e collaborativa, valori solidi e un forte impegno nello sviluppo e nella crescita. Ma soprattutto, sono le persone a fare la differenza e a renderci ciò che siamo. Fai il passo successivo nella tua carriera insieme a noi. Il viaggio inizia qui.​

jobs.title: Floor Manager, Spitalfields

Key Responsibilities Deliver a high level of customer service through expert styling advice, strong product knowledge, and an engaging store experience Analyse sales data and collaborate with the Store Manager to maximise department performance Lead and motivate a team of Sales Advisors to consistently achieve service and presentation standards Support recruitment efforts and ensure effective onboarding and training for new team members Identify and nurture future talent, contributing to development plans that support team progression Oversee daily store operations, ensuring efficiency and alignment with brand standards Act as a brand ambassador, consistently delivering the best possible experience for every customer Step into the role of Store when required, ensuring continuity in leadership and performance

jobs.title: Area Manager | Roma
jobs.description: WHAT YOU'LL DO As an Area Manager, you lead and develop a group of stores together with Store Managers to drive business performance, operational excellence, and an outstanding customer experience. Through coaching, collaboration, and strategic follow-up, you ensure consistent execution across your area while contributing to sustainable growth and strong people engagement.  You will:  Lead, commercial priorities.  Ensure stores operate according to H&M standards, policies, routines, and legal requirements.  Recruit, develop, and secure succession for future store leaders across the area.  Collaborate with key functions to translate business strategies into strong local execution.  Lead change initiatives, including store openings, operational rollouts, and new concepts.  Ensure excellent customer experiences through consistent store standards and coaching.  Oversee store maintenance, health & safety, sustainability, and operational efficiency.  Identify business opportunities, risks, and local market trends to support growth.  Act as the key escalation point for operational challenges and performance follow-up.  Who You'll Work With  You will work closely with Store Managers and store teams while partnering with colleagues across Commercial, Visual, Expansion, People, Tech, and Operations functions to drive business performance and aligned execution across your stores.    ​ WHO YOU’LL WORK WITH You will work closely with Store Managers, store teams, and Sales Market partners across Commercial, Visual, Expansion, People, and Operations functions leading and developing leaders and high-performing teams.  Strong commercial acumen and experience driving sales and KPI performance.  Experience analyzing business results and translating insights into actions.  Experience managing retail operations, compliance, and store standards.  Experience recruiting, developing, and building succession plans.  Experience leading operational rollouts, change, or business improvement initiatives.  Strong stakeholder management and cross-functional collaboration skills.  Fluency in English.  And people who are:  Customer-focused and results-driven.  Strong communicators who build trust and collaboration.  Confident decision-makers who use data and insights effectively.  Adaptable and comfortable in a fast-paced retail environment.  Inclusive leaders who foster engagement, accountability, and high performance.    WHO WE ARE H&M Group is a global company of strong fashion brands and ventures. Our goal is to prove that there is no compromise between exceptional design, affordable prices, and sustainable solutions. We want to liberate fashion for the many, and our customers are at the heart of every decision we make.​ We are made up of thousands of passionate and talented colleagues united by our shared culture and values. Together, we want to use our power, our scale, and our knowledge to push the fashion industry towards a more inclusive and sustainable future. ​    WHY YOU'LL LOVE WORKING HERE  At H&M Group, we are proud to be a dynamic and inclusive company. The experience our colleagues help create every day has also been recognized through awards such as:  Europe’s Best Employers 2026 – Financial Times  Top 10 Diversity Brand Index Italy  We offer attractive benefits and extensive development opportunities worldwide:  25% staff discount across all H&M Group brands, both in-store and online (H&M, COS, Weekday, Monki, H&M HOME, & Other Stories, and ARKET).  H&M Incentive Program (HIP), a global program that rewards long-term commitment and dedication.  Meal vouchers worth €6 for each working day of at least six hours.  Access to our corporate benefits platform, featuring more than 1,500 discounts on products and services that support everyday life and wellbeing.  Comprehensive onboarding and training, designed to help you get the best possible start in your new role.  Growth and development opportunities through continuous learning and structured development initiatives, including training programs, e-learning, Talent Days, Skill Seminars, and individual development dialogues. But most of all, it’s our people who make us who we are.​    ​ADDITIONAL INFORMATION   This is a full-time, permanent role. The gross annual salary (RAL) for this position starts from €46’000,00. The final offer will be determined based on professional experience, skills, and specific qualifications.  This role requires flexibility and availability to support business needs across the entire national territory.   ​*We are committed to a recruitment process that is fair, equitable, and based on competency. We therefore kindly ask you to not attach a cover letter to your application.​  ** To help us manage the high volume of applications for this role, we use a skills-based assessment as part of our recruitment process. Your responses will be evaluated using predefined criteria established by H&M Group, ensuring a fair and consistent assessment process for all candidates. After completing the assessment, you will have the opportunity to provide feedback and ask any questions you may have.  For more information about how we process your personal data, please refer to our Privacy Notice.

jobs.title: Senior Freelance Womenswear Designer
jobs.description: At COS, we believe in the power of creative collaboration and the art of timeless design. jobs.title: Service Reliability Engineer (GVMC)
jobs.description: Role purpose Monitor and support the operational health of Sky’s Mobile Data, Mobile Voice and Fixed networks. The role provides 24/7 eyes-on-glass monitoring, incident triage, first-line resolution and clear escalation to protect service availability and customer experience. What you’ll do Monitor Mobile Data, Mobile Voice and Fixed network services, alarms, events and performance indicators. Identify , triage and resolve incidents affecting 4G, 5G, IMS, VoLTE, VoWiFi and fixed voice services. Use monitoring and network management tools to detect service degradation and take action before wider customer impact. Raise and manage incident tickets, follow operational playbooks and engage the correct support, engineering, supplier or partner teams. Support planned network changes through pre-checks, post- checks and service validation. Provide concise operational updates, maintain accurate records and contribute to improved procedures and knowledge articles. Work as part of a 24/7 service reliability function and remain calm and effective during major incidents. Essential knowledge and experience A strong telecommunications background, preferably gained in a network operations , service assurance or engineering environment. Essential working knowledge of 4G, 5 G and IMS, including mobile data and voice service behaviour and common failure scenarios. Understanding of VoLTE and VoWiFi, mobile core and signalling concepts, and IP networking fundamentals. Experience monitoring live telecoms services and interpreting alarms, logs, dashboards and performance information. Experience of incident, problem and change management within an operational environment. Clear communication skills for both technical and non-technical audiences, with a strong team and customer focus. Desirable Experience with mobile core, IMS or fixed voice platforms and vendors. Knowledge of GTP, SIP, Diameter, SS7/SIGTRAN, roaming or MVNO operations. Exposure to cloud-native network functions, automation or modern observability tools. The team Service Reliability provides the 24/7 operational contact point for Group Networks. The team monitors services, coordinates incidents, carries out approved recovery actions and works with engineering teams, suppliers and partners to restore service safely and quickly.

jobs.title: Service Reliability Manager (GNSP)
jobs.description: Job Description We’re Sky, Europe’s biggest entertainment brand. Think top-quality shows. Breaking news. Innovative tech. Must-have products. Careers here mean the freedom and support you need to make an impact – pushing boundaries, creating solutions, hitting targets. As part of our close-knit team, you’ll enjoy plenty of benefits, plus experiences you’ll only find at Sky. What you’ll do Lead from the front – manage and technically guide a team of Service Reliability Engineers across a complex, high-availability network environment. Own network operational readiness – lead service introduction and change, ensuring new network technologies and platforms transition effectively into live operations. Use AI/ML to automate network operations – apply AI and machine learning to reduce manual activity, improve monitoring, accelerate diagnostics and automate repeatable operational processes. Take control during major incidents – act as Duty Operations Manager, providing technical leadership, coordinating response and driving rapid service restoration. Drive network reliability and improvement – use performance data, incident trends and root-cause analysis to identify and deliver measurable improvements. Raise the technical standard – strengthen engineering playbooks, assurance, compliance and operational capability across the Service Reliability function. What you’ll bring CCNP-level network expertise – certification is desirable, but the technical depth is essential, with the credibility to guide and challenge experienced Network Engineers. Deep service-provider networking knowledge – including IP core, MPLS, routing, switching, access, transmission, firewalls and load balancing. Strong end-to-end network understanding – across IP, ISP, cloud, voice, mobile and CDN environments. Hands-on automation experience – practical experience using scripting, APIs, orchestration or automation tooling within network operations. Experience using AI/ML to automate operational activity – applying AI and machine learning to areas such as event correlation, diagnostics, monitoring, predictive insight and automated remediation. Strong technical leadership – proven experience leading complex network incidents and change while driving continuous improvement across a telecoms environment. Team overview: Service Reliability The Service Reliability team is responsible for the 24/7 running of Sky’s telecoms network. It provides the primary 24/7 service desk for Group Networks routing incident tickets both within the department and to other on-call support teams within Group Networks. The department is directly responsible for executing playbooks for problem resolution within the Access and IP network domains. Inclusion & how you'll work: Recognised by The Times and Stonewall, we take pride in our approach to diversity and inclusion. Investing in society, fighting racial injustice and setting ambitious targets for representation at Sky. We’ve embraced hybrid working and split our time between unique office spaces and the convenience of working from home. You’ll find out more about what hybrid working looks like for your role later on in the recruitment process. Your office space: Brick Lane: Our Brick Lane office is in the heart of the East End of London. It’s part of a vibrant and varied community; close to street food, cafes, and shops. The closest tube station is Aldgate East and Liverpool Street is about a 10-minute walk. Top Tips: To find out more about the team and opportunity, and to support you in the application process, we encourage reaching out to the Hiring Manager for a conversation about the role before applying. Preparation is key - make sure to review the interview details provided by the recruiter and prepare accordingly to give yourself the best chance for success Don’t forget to set up job alerts on Careers at Sky to be the first to hear when new roles open. Explore Sky Learn for a range of online courses, learning and toolkits to support you in your career development and build future skills.

jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer QA - Entertainment Release
jobs.description: We believe in better. And we make it happen. Better content. Better products. And better careers. Working in Tech, Product or Data at Sky is about building the next and the new. From broadband to broadcast, streaming to mobile, SkyQ to Sky Glass, we never stand still. We optimise and innovate. We turn big ideas into the products, content and services millions of people love. And we do it all right here at Sky. What You’ll Do: In the role of Senior Software Engineer (Entertainment Release QA) you will develop automation solutions for ensuring quality, reliability and performance of our products including Smart TV and streaming devices on features such as video playback, content discovery, user experience, streaming integrity, add integration, parental control, network handling, audio/video sync. Tooling and Test Automation Infrastructure - Get familiar with automation tools and frameworks for test development, execution, and reporting. Maintaining test automation, including selecting appropriate tools, configuring environments, and integrating with version control systems. Collaboration and Communication Skills - Practice agile methodologies to enhance teamwork and productivity. Participate in cross-functional activities such as joint sprint planning, backlog grooming, and retrospective meetings to foster alignment and shared understanding across teams. BDD and Test Automation - Develop and execute high-quality test plans efficiently on RDK stacks while leveraging automation and tooling to detect defects quickly and ensure the reliability of test coverages. BDD and Test Automation - Explore advanced topics such as test data management, scenario refactoring, and integrating BDD with continuous integration/continuous deployment (CI/CD) pipelines. What You’ll Bring: Expert level experience of building and maintaining full stack development in Java, Python and JavaScript Automating solutions in Cypress and Automatics Framework. Deep analytical skills in root cause identification of defects on Smart TV and Streaming Device with streaming app, audio/video syncs and interoperability user experience testing Strong automation development in onboarding Smart TV and Stream devices, airplay, ATSC, Bluetooth & HDMI input, Deep Sleep mode, content in VOD and Linear channel and native apps. Strong DevOps Practices experience where you will provide Full Lifecycle Ownership, Comprehensive Solutioning. Observability and Oversight, Process Optimisation, Collaboration and Integration and Operationalisation. Strong BDD and Test Automation and Infrastructure experience. Good understanding of Business-Driven Development Strategy. Fully familiar with automation tools and frameworks for test development, execution and reporting. Strong Reliability Engineering and Test Coverage Optimisation. Explore strategies for optimizing test coverage, such as risk-based testing, equivalence partitioning, and prioritizing critical paths. Leading strategy definition and driving process improvements in quality of product releases Team overview: The RDK Pre-Release Operations Engineering Organisation is dedicated to ensuring the highest standards of product certification, precision, and readiness before market release. Through comprehensive operational oversight and stringent quality processes, we leverage advanced tooling and methodologies to continually elevate our quality standards. The team focus on solutions of ensuring product certification for Sky Hub products. Global Product We’re the Global Product. We’re the team behind your favourite Sky products, and the platforms that power them. We make every moment magical, everywhere. Our team is made up of self-motivated, big thinkers who have a knack for solving problems and find new ways to captivate millions of customers by putting them at the heart of everything we do. From Sky Glass, Sky Q, Peacock and NOW to news and sports apps, we make entertainment even better, and we can’t wait to get started on what’s next. The rewards: There's one thing people can't stop talking about when it comes to #LifeAtSky: the perks. Here’s a taster: Sky Q, for the TV you love all in one place The magic of Sky Glass at an exclusive rate A generous pension package Private healthcare Discounted mobile and broadband A wide range of Sky VIP rewards and experiences Inclusion & how you'll work: We are a Disability Confident Employer, and welcome and encourage applications from all candidates. We will look to ensure a fair and consistent experience for all, and will make reasonable adjustments to support you where appropriate. Please flag any adjustments you need to your recruiter as early as you can. We’ve embraced hybrid working and split our time between unique office spaces and the convenience of working from home. Your office space: Brentwood: Our location takes some beating: we’re practically in Brentwood station, which has regular trains to London Liverpool Street. If you find it easier to drive, there’s some onsite parking, while Chatham Way car park is a short walk away. We'd love to hear from you Inventive, forward-thinking minds come together to work in Tech, Product and Data at Sky. It’s a place where you can explore what if, how far, and what next. But better doesn’t stop at what we do, it’s how we do it, too. We embrace each other’s differences. We support our community and contribute to a sustainable future for our business and the planet. If you believe in better, we’ll back you all the way. Just so you know: if your application is successful, we’ll ask you to complete a criminal record check. And depending on the role you have applied for and the nature of any convictions you may have, we might have to withdraw the offer.

jobs.title: Manager Data Scientist
jobs.description: About us Sky is the technology and media company that makes entertainment and connectivity a personal, simple, and seamless experience. Our motto is We Believe in Better : we believe people deserve the very best, and we innovate every day to create value and simplify our customers’ lives. As part of Sky Group and Comcast, we operate in an international environment driven by continuous innovation and powered by world-class technology that allows us to reach millions of people every day. With an IP-first approach, we design cutting-edge technology platforms – Sky Stream, Sky Q, Sky Glass, and NOW – that bring together premium content, trusted news, and world-class sports within a simple and intuitive ecosystem. We connect with audiences across Italy through our free-to-air channels – TV8, Cielo, and Sky TG24 – and go beyond entertainment with Sky Wifi and Sky Mobile, offering ultra-fast connectivity at home and on the go. This is how we deliver the joy of a better experience, guided by our values: Creative. We are ambitious and innovative, embracing new technologies and leveraging insights to stay one step ahead, continuously raising the bar for our customers. Welcoming. We are inclusive, collaborative, and respectful, creating a strong sense of belonging. Simplifying. We focus on what matters most, set clear priorities, bring clarity, and remove complexity. Do the Right Thing. We build a culture of clarity, fairness, and trust, supported by transparent processes and decisions people can rely on. Role: Manager Data Scientist We are looking for a Data Science Manager who combines strong hands-on expertise with strategic leadership. This is not a traditional people-management role: you will operate primarily as a senior individual contributor, while acting as the data science lead on high-impact, cross-functional initiatives. You will own complex projects end-to-end, partnering with business and technology stakeholders to turn data into measurable business impact. You will play a pivotal role in bridging business challenges and advanced analytics, shaping how data science is applied across the organization and elevating both its impact and maturity. What you will do: Lead data science projects from problem framing to production deployment Make key decisions on methodology, trade-offs, and technical direction Develop and deploy machine learning and AI models to drive customer value and operational efficiency Act as Data Lead on strategic initiatives, and serve as the go-to data science expert on critical, cross-functional programs Translate ambiguous business questions into structured analytical problems Drive alignment between stakeholders and ensure delivery of tangible, measurable outcomes Stay deeply hands-on Apply advanced analytics techniques in complex, multi-source and big data environments Promote high standards in code quality, reproducibility, and model governance Support adoption of responsible and ethical AI practices Provide guidance and mentorship to junior data scientists Foster a culture of ownership, pragmatism, and continuous improvement Partner with business stakeholders to identify high-impact opportunities Communicate complex analytical insights in a clear, compelling, and actionable way Drive data adoption and data-driven decision making across the organization Your profile: Almeno 4 years of experience in data science or advanced analytics roles Proven ability to own projects end-to-end in production environments Strong track record of working in ambiguous, fast-paced environments Natural ownership mindset: you don’t just build models—you drive impact Machine learning (supervised, unsupervised, semi-supervised) Statistical modeling and experimentation Advanced proficiency in: Python (Pandas, NumPy, Scikit-learn, etc.), SQL, and/or R Productionization and collaboration with engineering teams Solid understanding of Data pipelines and large-scale data processing Experience with version control (Git) Ability to connect data work to real business outcomes and KPIs Experience interacting with stakeholders and influencing decisions Capability to identify and prioritize high-value use cases Experience leading projects or initiatives, even without direct reports Experience mentoring or coaching other data scientists Fluency in English and Italian is required What we offer: For employees covered by the Private Radio and Television Collective Labour Agreement (CCNL) , compensation starts from €51,000 gross per year . Permanent employment contract. Compensation commensurate with experience and specific skills. Eligibility for the annual incentive scheme. Access to Sky’s wellbeing programme, Sky4You , designed to support employees throughout different stages of life. Benefits include: Free access to Sky TV services through Sky Q or Sky Stream. Sky Wifi and Sky Mobile at exclusive employee rates. Private healthcare insurance extendable to family members and cohabitants. Life and accident insurance. Free access to the company gym (Milan office only). Financial support for new parents and caregivers. Free tax return assistance. Meal vouchers. Additional initiatives focused on mental, physical, and financial wellbeing, summer camps and language courses for children, as well as a range of discounts and partnerships. Hybrid Working Hybrid working that truly works. Depending on your role, you can benefit from up to 12 days per month of remote working , while our offices provide inspiring spaces where people collaborate, innovate, and make decisions together. Our Milan hub is located in Rogoredo, Santa Giulia district , just a few minutes’ walk from Milano Rogoredo Station (M3 Rogoredo FS, regional and high-speed trains, suburban rail services), with convenient bus connections and easy access by car or motorcycle. At the Sky Campus, you'll find cafés, a company restaurant, Sky Cinema, and collaborative spaces designed to foster innovation and idea-sharing. The surrounding area also offers restaurants, bars, supermarkets, and a wide range of services. Learning & Development: At Sky , we invest in your growth. We believe in internal mobility as a key driver of professional development and offer opportunities to explore new roles and career paths across the organization. Through Sky Learn , our learning platform, you will have access to continuous training, digital learning content, and upskilling and reskilling programmes to help you grow, evolve, and build your future career. Social Impact & Inclusion At Sky , we believe in people. We are committed to creating a diverse, equitable, and inclusive workplace where everyone can be themselves and achieve their full potential. We actively support wellbeing and ensure equal opportunities for all, including candidates belonging to protected categories under Italian Law 68/99. Sky hosts several employee networks, including Body&Mind, LGBTQ+, Women@Sky, and Parents&Carers —voluntary communities that bring colleagues together to promote wellbeing, inclusion, and empowerment initiatives. We strive every day to create a lasting positive impact on our communities through Sky Cares volunteering programmes , Sky Up digital education initiatives , and immersive educational experiences offered through the Academy Studios . Why Wait? Apply now to build an extraordinary career and join a brilliant team. We can’t wait to meet you. At Sky, ideas become experiences for millions of people. Sky welcomes every form of talent. jobs.title: Software Engineer
jobs.description: About us Sky è la tech media company che rende l’intrattenimento e la connettività un’esperienza personale, semplice e senza confini. Il nostro motto è We Believe in Better : crediamo che le persone meritino il meglio e innoviamo ogni giorno per creare valore e semplificare la vita dei nostri clienti. Siamo parte di Sky Group e del mondo Comcast , operiamo in una realtà internazionale orientata all’innovazione continua e sostenuta da una tecnologia di eccellenza che ci permette di raggiungere ogni giorno milioni di persone. Con un approccio IP‑first progettiamo piattaforme tecnologiche all’avanguardia – Sky Stream, Sky Q, Sky Glass e NOW – che integrano contenuti premium, informazione autorevole e non-stop, grandi eventi sportivi in un ecosistema semplice e intuitivo. Parliamo a tutto il Paese anche attraverso i canali Free to air – TV8, Cielo e Sky TG24 – e andiamo oltre l’intrattenimento con Sky Wifi e Sky Mobile , offrendo connettività ultraveloce dentro e fuori casa. È così che portiamo la joy of a better experience , guidati dai nostri valori: Creative. Siamo ambiziosi e innovativi, abbracciando le nuove tecnologie e utilizzando gli insight per rimanere un passo avanti, alzando l’asticella della qualità per i nostri clienti. Welcoming. Siamo inclusivi, collaborativi e rispettosi, creando un senso di appartenenza. Simplifying. Ci concentriamo su ciò che conta davvero, definiamo le priorità, portiamo chiarezza ed eliminiamo la complessità Do the right thing . Costruiamo una cultura basata su chiarezza, equità e fiducia con processi trasparenti e decisioni in cui le persone possano avere fiducia Ruolo: Solution Engineer Entra a far parte del team IT Revenue Management, all’interno dell’area Solution Engineering, dove potrai contribuire — mettendo in gioco le tue competenze — a guidare lo sviluppo di soluzioni innovative e il costante miglioramento dei processi che favoriscono la crescita e l’eccellenza dell’organizzazione. La struttura di Solution Engineering ha il compito di gestire lo sviluppo applicativo e l’operatività nei seguenti domini: Rating and Billing (BRM) Commissioning Revenue Assurance Antifrode Voucher Management Collection Subscriber Revenues Nel ruolo, guiderai il ciclo di vita dei progetti sull’area, occupandoti dell’analisi dei requisiti, della definizione delle soluzioni, della pianificazione e del monitoraggio delle relative implementazioni. Sarai responsabile della qualità degli sviluppi, del rispetto delle scadenze e dell’uso ottimale delle risorse. Cosa farai: Esperienza consolidata di almeno 3 anni su Oracle BRM in contesti telco e servizi digitali complessi, con competenze approfondite in Product Configuration, Pricing & Rating, Billing & Invoicing, Account & Customer Management Solida conoscenza del Data Model BRM e comprovata esperienza nell’integrazione con sistemi esterni Interfacciarsi con gli stakeholder aziendali per definire soluzioni, tempi e costi Coordinare e supervisionare i progetti, garantendo il rispetto di scadenze e budget Analizzare i requisiti di business e collaborare con il team per la definizione della soluzione, contribuendo attivamente alla definizione della soluzione e degli impatti Valutare gli impatti di implementazione in termini di risorse e tempistiche Definire strategie di mitigazione dei rischi ed eventuali azioni correttive Assicurare coerenza e qualità degli output di progetto Monitorare l’avanzamento dei progetti e preparare adeguata reportistica per il management Garantire la coerenza funzionale/tecnica ed economica del progetto rispetto alle fasi dello stesso Verificare e validare la documentazione di rilascio dei progetti garantendo gli standard IT Fornire supporto tecnico e funzionale per individuazione dei problemi e l’accettazione e verifica delle soluzioni proposte. Il tuo profilo: Esperienza nella gestione del budget e nel coordinamento di team di lavoro Competenze di analisi funzionale e disegno di soluzioni tecniche Conoscenze tecniche di alto livello Conoscenza dei processi di Billing, Collection, Commissioning, Antifrode e Revenue Assurance Esperienza nella gestione di fornitori IT Metodologie di Project management (agile, waterfall), certificazioni sono un plus Ottime capacità di comunicazione, organizzazione, problem solving e team building Ottima conoscenza della lingua inglese (parlata e scritta) Familiarità con i processi in ambito Telco e Media Laurea in Ingegneria Elettronica/Telecomunicazioni/Informatica o affini Cosa offriamo: Per il CCNL Radio e televisioni private la retribuzione è a partire da: 39.000 € Tipologia contrattuale: Tempo indeterminato La retribuzione effettiva sarà commisurata alla esperienza maturata e alle competenze specifiche possedute. La posizione è inoltre eligible al sistema incentivante annuale. Sky considera prioritario fornire un ambiente di lavoro sano, stimolante e attento alle esigenze individuali, sia nella sfera quotidiana che professionale. In quest’ottica nasce Sky4You, il programma di Wellbeing concepito per accompagnare ogni persona nelle diverse fasi della vita, alcuni esempi di ciò che avrai a disposizione: Accesso gratuito all’offerta televisiva Sky tramite Sky Q o Sky Stream Sky Wifi e Sky Mobile a condizioni riservate ed esclusive Assicurazione sanitaria estendibile ai familiari e conviventi Polizza vita e infortuni Accesso gratuito alla palestra aziendale [solo sede di Milano] Sostegno economico per neo genitori e caregiver Assistenza gratuita per la dichiarazione dei redditi Buoni pasto A questi si aggiungono iniziative dedicate al benessere psico-fisico e finanziario, campus estivi e corsi di lingua per figli/e, oltre a convenzioni e sconti riservati. Hybrid Working Lavoro ibrido che funziona davvero. In base al tuo ruolo potrai usufruire fino a un massimo di 12 giorni al mese di smart working per concentrarti senza distrazioni, in ufficio potrai confrontarti, creare insieme e prendere decisioni in spazi unici pensati per collaborare e dare il meglio di te. Il nostro hub di Milano si trova a Rogoredo , nel quartiere Santa Giulia , a pochi minuti a piedi dalla stazione Milano Rogoredo (M3 Rogoredo FS, treni regionali/AV, Passante), zona ben servita anche da un servizio di bus . Facile da raggiungere anche in auto e motocicli , grazie ai collegamenti con le principali arterie cittadine. Nello Sky Campus troverai: due bar, ristorante aziendale, lo Sky Cinema e vari spazi collaborativi dedicati all’innovazione e alla condivisione di idee. Nei dintorni troverai altri bar, ristoranti, supermercati e servizi vari. Formazione e crescita: In Sky investiamo nella tua crescita. Crediamo nella mobilità interna come leva concreta di sviluppo e ti offriamo opportunità per esplorare nuovi ruoli e percorsi all’interno dell’azienda. Con Sky Learn , la nostra piattaforma di apprendimento, avrai accesso a formazione continua, contenuti digitali e percorsi di upskilling e reskilling per crescere, evolvere e costruire il tuo futuro professionale. Social Impact & Inclusion In Sky crediamo nelle persone. Ci impegniamo a creare un ambiente diverso, equo e inclusivo , in cui ogni persona possa sentirsi sé stessa ed esprimere il proprio potenziale. Sosteniamo attivamente il benessere e garantiamo pari opportunità a tutti , incluse le persone appartenenti alle categorie protette (Legge 68/99) . In quest’ottica, l’azienda ospita i network Body&Mind , LGBTQ+ , Women@Sky e Parents&Carers : community volontarie che riuniscono colleghi interessati a confrontarsi e promuovere iniziative dedicate al benessere, all’inclusione e all’empowerment femminile. Lavoriamo ogni giorno per generare un impatto positivo e duraturo sulle comunità, grazie alle iniziative di volontariato Sky Cares , ai programmi di educazione digitale di SkyUp e alle esperienze immersive delle company visit degli Academy Studios. Perché aspettare? Candidati ora per costruire una carriera straordinaria ed entrare a far parte di un team brillante. Non vediamo l’ora di conoscerti! I n Sky le idee diventano esperienze per milioni di persone. Sky favorisce l’inserimento di ogni forma di talento. Tutte le candidature, incluse quelle appartenenti alle categorie protette ai sensi della Legge 68/99, saranno considerate in ottica di pari opportunità e inclusione, senza discriminazioni di alcun tipo. Sky Italia garantisce un processo di selezione equo, inclusivo e non discriminatorio. In coerenza con questo impegno e con il D. Lgs 96/2026, Sky Italia non richiede né raccoglie informazioni sulla retribuzione o sull’inquadramento pregressi dei/delle candidati/e, né durante i colloqui, né contatti individuali e/o attraverso altri soggetti terzi coinvolti nel processo.

jobs.title: Fragrance & Beauty Sales Consultant - John Lewis Oxford Street
jobs.description: Fragrance & Beauty Sales Consultant Location: John Lewis Oxford Street Contract: Permanent, 37.5 hours/week, any 5 in 7 days CHANEL is an independent company that believes in the freedom of creation, cultivates human potential, and acts to have a positive impact in the world. “In order to be irreplaceable, one must always be different” stated company founder, Gabrielle Chanel. At CHANEL, we strive to identify what is unique in each person and support them through their journey with the brand. Our mission at CHANEL Beauty is to underline what is most unique in every person and give our clients the confidence to become the true expression of themselves through exceptional fragrance, makeup and skincare creations. Your role @CHANEL: As a Fragrance & Beauty Sales Consultant, you are the ultimate CHANEL ambassador and you will play a key role in our mission, embodying our values and DNA. What impact you can create at CHANEL: Build long lasting client relationships through a tailored, memorable experience both in-store and through digital channels Share passion and knowledge in fragrance, makeup, and skincare with confidence through storytelling Deliver expert personalised consultations that captivate and educate clients Use clienteling and data capture tools to actively recruit new clients and grow client portfolio Help achieve individual and counter sales targets & KPIs What you will bring to the role: Experience in a client-facing retail environment A passion for client experience Ability to quickly build rapport and create meaningful client connections A collaborative and team-first mindset You are energised by: Creating memorable experiences for clients Working in a collaborative environment that encourages people to perform their best Using empathy and insight to understand client needs Achieving sustainable growth and performance based on targets and KPIs Contributing in the on-going and companywide version of sustainability. Sustainability is one of CHANEL’s key performance drivers, embedded into our ways of working we require continued collective action from all employees to deliver on CHANEL’s House Sustainability Ambitions across our four key areas: Restoring Nature and Climate Investing in Circularity Advancing dignity and prosperity Promoting the autonomy of women What will you gain from this experience: The opportunity to be part of a globally recognised luxury brand known for its timeless heritage You will be empowered to take ownership of your impact within CHANEL You will work alongside inspirational colleagues and managers that will coach and develop you throughout your CHANEL career journey You will be immersed in a House of creation and luxury through attending inspirational conferences and training initiatives in our Training Academy to elevate your expertise to educate and inspire our clients Benefits at CHANEL: Our employee benefits have been created to support you across your professional and personal life by offering you: Physical Wellbeing: Private Medical Insurance covering pre-existing medical conditions and ability to add family members, Online GP App with 24/7 appointments available within 24 hours and Cycle Scheme participation for a tax-exempt bike and/or accessories Financial Wellbeing: Pension, Life Assurance and Retail Discounts across multiple retailers including Supermarkets, Gyms, Days Out and 100’s more Mental Wellbeing: Employee Assistance Programmes and Other Support Lines Lifestyle: Arts & Culture Ticket Discounts across major London attractions, CHANEL Product Discounts and Employee Only Sales Employee Recognition: Service Awards Programme offering CHANEL Products, Retail Vouchers and Additional Holidays across milestones *Benefits are eligibility dependant and subject to change at any time At CHANEL, we are focused on creating an inclusive culture that nurtures personal growth, contributing to collective progress. We believe the uniqueness of each individual increases the diversity, complementarity, and effectiveness of our teams. We strongly encourage your application, as we value the perspective, experience and potential you could bring to CHANEL.

jobs.title: Fashion Advisor, Walton Street
jobs.description: Fashion Advisor Location: CHANEL Walton Street Contract: Permanent, Full-time CHANEL is committed to delivering the ultimate luxury experience across all client touchpoints. From our Fashion boutiques with our Fashion Advisors, to online on CHANEL.COM or via our client care teams, we endeavour to provide an elevated, seamless, and memorable client experience. YOUR ROLE @CHANEL: The successful candidate will play a pivotal role in creating desire through navigating the core of fashion trends and shaping the narrative of luxury. In this role you will utilise your strong interpersonal skills and connect with clients at all levels, effectively, creating a welcoming and engaging atmosphere. As a Fashion Advisor, you will collaborate closely with colleagues daily, contributing to a cohesive, collaborative team environment and elevating the standards of excellence. WHAT IMPACT YOU CAN CREATE@CHANEL: Cultivate genuine relationships to foster trust and ensure enduring loyalty from our clientele reflecting the essence of the brand. Tailor and offer personalised guidance that elevates our clients’ journey through showcasing an in depth understanding of individual preferences and lifestyles Maintain an organised approach when completing tasks, ensuring efficiency and attention to detail Foster a culture of collective brilliance and creativity within the boutique and champion the brand’s legacy of excellence through inspiring colleagues to uphold the highest standards of luxury service. WHAT YOU WILL BRING TO THE ROLE Ability to build authentic, lasting relationships through empathy and personalised service Strong awareness of trends and deep appreciation for Chanel’s heritage and style. Confident, elegant storytelling and interpersonal skills to engage clients meaningfully. Collaborative attitude to foster a positive, high-performing boutique environment. Organized, efficient, and committed to delivering excellence in every task. YOU ARE ENERGISED BY: A genuine love for establishing meaningful connections with new clients and contributing to exceptional client service while creating memorable experiences Exploring and learning about the ever-evolving world of fashion while demonstrating a comprehensive understanding of industry trends Being part of a creative and innovative environment where teamwork is valued and encouraged WHAT YOU WILL GAIN FROM THIS EXPERIENCE: Gaining deeper insights from a leading player in the luxury fashion market, understanding cultural nuances, consumer behaviour, and the latest developments shaping the industry. Acquiring hands-on experience with CRM systems, which are widely used in the fashion industry to manage client interactions and preferences effectively. jobs.title: Client Data Manager
jobs.description: Location: London, UK Role Overview The Pioneer Programme has established a global, three-divisional client data platform that contributes to the ultimate client experience for CHANEL, enabling international client recognition. Bringing together 200+ internal and external stakeholders across Business, IT, Legal, Regions and Divisions, it fosters cross-functional collaboration around a shared client-centric vision. As part of the Global PMO, you will lead key global client data management initiatives, partnering with Business, IT, Legal, Security, Data Governance and external partners to drive scalable, compliant and client-focused solutions. You will play a central role in shaping data governance, data quality, privacy and client data capabilities while ensuring alignment across a complex global organisation. This role requires strong expertise in client data management, stakeholder engagement, governance and project delivery within an international matrix environment. Reports to: Head of Global PMO – Pioneer Key Responsibilities Client Data Management & Governance Act as the primary point of contact for Business stakeholders on all client data management topics. Define, maintain and continuously improve client data management frameworks, including client matching and merging rules, calculated fields, business rules and data quality controls. Drive initiatives to improve data quality, completeness, consistency and accuracy across client data platforms, within Regions and Divisions. Lead the development, governance and evolution of the client data model, ensuring alignment with business requirements and enterprise data standards. Support the definition and implementation of data governance principles, roles, responsibilities and core client data management processes. Act as Global Data Steward, driving best practices, governance standards and data ownership across Regions and Divisions. Facilitate and animate the global Data Steward community through training, guidance, documentation and knowledge-sharing activities. Data Privacy & Compliance Lead the design, harmonisation and continuous improvement of global client data privacy processes, including Data Subject Rights to Access, Modification and Erasure, as well as the implementation of the Global Client Data Retention Policy. Partner with Legal, Security and Regional teams to ensure compliance with applicable privacy regulations and internal governance requirements. Support the development of scalable and automated privacy solutions across markets. Analytics Support the enhancement of client analytics capabilities through the evolutions of calculated fields, KPI definitions and reporting requirements. Establish and maintain client data quality monitoring frameworks and dashboards, coordinating cross-functional analysis, remediation and preventive actions to improve data accuracy, completeness and consistency. Programme & Stakeholder Management Coordinate complex, cross-functional client data initiatives involving business, technical and external stakeholders. Lead stakeholder discussions to gather requirements, assess impacts, identify risks and propose pragmatic solutions. Support the preparation of governance materials, executive presentations, roadmaps, guidelines and decision-making documentation for steering committees and leadership forums. Monitor progress, risks, dependencies and action plans across multiple projects and regions. Documentation & Knowledge Management Own and maintain client data documentation, governance practices, process flows, business rules and operational processes. Manage and continuously update the central knowledge repository (WikiPioneer/SharePoint), ensuring documentation remains accurate, accessible and up to date. Support change management and training initiatives through the creation of user guides, standards and communication materials. Team Leadership Provide day-to-day guidance, coaching and prioritisation support to the Client Data Coordinator and the Global Data Steward Intern Foster collaboration, team engagement and strong cross-functional relationships across the Pioneer community. Required Experience Significant experience in client data management, data governance, data quality or master data management initiatives. Hands-on experience with client data analytics, KPI development, reporting and data quality analysis, combined with a strong analytical mindset and the ability to translate data into insights. Strong knowledge of CRM, customer data platforms and client journeys. Experience managing complex cross-functional projects and transformation programmes in an international environment. Proven ability to work across Business, IT, Legal, Security and external partner organisations. Experience defining business requirements, operating models, governance frameworks and process improvements. Knowledge of data privacy regulations and client data lifecycle management. Experience with client data platforms, data stewardship practices and analytics solutions is highly desirable. Key Skills & Competencies Client Data Management & Governance Data Stewardship & Data Quality Management Master Data Management (MDM) CRM & Customer Experience Client Data Analytics & Insights Analytical Thinking & Data-Driven Decision Making Data Privacy & Compliance Business Analysis & Requirements Management Project & Programme Management Stakeholder Management & Influencing Change Management & Training Risk & Incident Management Process Design & Continuous Improvement Communication & Executive Presentation Skills What We're Looking For The successful candidate will be customer-focused, collaborative and highly effective at navigating complex stakeholder environments. They will combine analytical thinking with strong communication skills, be comfortable operating with ambiguity, and demonstrate the ability to influence, align and drive outcomes across a global matrix organisation. They will thrive on solving complex problems, building collaborative relationships, and delivering sustainable, scalable solutions that strengthen CHANEL's client data capabilities worldwide.
